ABOUT THE JOB Do you know why Domino's Pizza hires so many drivers? Well, aside from the fact that our delicious pizza is the perfect solution for dinner for families all across the nation - we do it because we can. What do we mean by that, you ask? We mean that we offer a great flexible schedule that offers the hours you're looking for. That means you're free when you need to be. You'll have plenty of time left over for school, to hang with your friends, or whatever. Even if you need a second job for some extra cash, Domino's Pizza is the perfect place for you. Right now Domino's is looking for qualified drivers to staff stores in your area. We're growing so fast it's hard to keep up, and that means Domino's has lots of ways for you to grow (if that's what you want), perhaps to management, perhaps beyond. Whether it's your hobby, main-gig, or supplemental job, apply online. We're bound to have just the thing for you.

JOB REQUIREMENTS AND DUTIES You must be 18 years of age and have a valid driver's license with a safe driving record meeting company standards as well as access to an insured vehicle which can be used for delivery. You should possess navigational skills to read a map, locate addresses within designated delivery area and must be able to navigate adverse terrain including multi-story buildings.

ADVANCEMENT Many of our team members began their careers as delivery drivers and today are successful Domino's franchise owners. From delivery driver to management, general manager to franchisee or Manager Corporate Operations, our stores offer a world of opportunity.

DIVERSITY Our mission is to recognize, appreciate, value and utilize the unique talents and contributions of all individuals. To create an environment where all team members, because of their differences, can reach their highest potential.

SUMMARY STATEMENT We take pride in our team members and our team members take pride in Domino's Pizza! Being the best pizza delivery company in the world requires exceptional team members working together. At Domino's Pizza, our people come first!

General Job Duties For All Store Team Members Operate all equipment. Stock ingredients from delivery area to storage, work area, walk-in cooler. Prepare product. Receive and process telephone orders. Take inventory and complete associated paperwork. Clean equipment and facility approximately daily.

Training Orientation and training provided on the job.

Communication Skills Ability to comprehend and give correct written instructions. Ability to communicate verbally with customers and co-workers to process orders both over the phone and in person.

Essential Functions/Skills Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide accurately and quickly (may use calculator). Must be able to make correct monetary change. Verbal, writing, and telephone skills to take and process orders. Motor coordination between eyes and hands/fingers to rapidly and accurately make precise movements with speed. Ability to enter orders using a computer keyboard or touch screen. Navigational skills to read a map, locate addresses within designated delivery area. Must navigate adverse terrain including multi-story buildings, private homes, and other delivery sites while carrying product.

Work Conditions

EXPOSURE TO Varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions when removing trash and performing other outside tasks. In-store temperatures range from 36 degrees in cooler to 90 degrees and above in some work areas. Sudden changes in temperature in work area and while outside. Fumes from food odors. Exposure to cornmeal dust. Cramped quarters including walk-in cooler. Hot surfaces/tools from oven up to 500 degrees or higher. Sharp edges and moving mechanical parts. Varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions when delivering product, driving and couponing.

SENSING Talking and hearing on telephone. Near and mid-range vision for most in-store tasks. Depth perception. Ability to differentiate between hot and cold surfaces. Far vision and night vision for driving.

TEMPERAMENTS The ability to direct activities, perform repetitive tasks, work alone and with others, work under stress, meet strict quality control standards, deal with people, analyze and compile data, make judgements and decisions.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS, including, but not limited to the following:

Standing Most tasks are performed from a standing position. Walking surfaces include ceramic tile bricks with linoleum in some food process areas. Height of work surfaces is between 36 and 48.

Walking For short distances for short durations Delivery personnel must travel between the store and delivery vehicle and from the delivery vehicle to the customer's location.

Sitting Paperwork is normally completed in an office at a desk or table

Lifting Bulk product deliveries are made twice a week or more and are unloaded by the team member using a hand truck. Deliveries may include cases of ingredients and supplies weighing up to 50 pounds with dimensions of up to 3' x 1.5'. Cases are usually lifted from floor and stacked onto shelves up to 72 high.

Carrying Large cans, weighing 3 pounds, 7 ounces, are carried from the workstation to storage shelves. Occasionally, pizza sauce weighing 30 pounds is carried from the storage room to the front of the store. Trays of pizza dough are carried three at a time over short distances, and weigh approximately 12 pounds per tray. During delivery, carry pizzas and beverages while performing walking and climbing duties.

Pushing To move trays which are placed on dollies. A stack of trays on a dolly is approximately 24 - 30 and requires a force of up to 7.5 pounds to push. Trays may also be pulled.

DuBois brands have been recognized as the technical leader for over one hundred years with unparalleled technology and service. No other company offers the performance value of our product offerings. Support the development, execution, and ongoing refinement of pricing strategies that align with company objectives, market conditions, and customer value.

Manage pricing support for customer proposals, bids, and RFP responses by delivering accurate, timely, and competitive pricing analyses.

Build, maintain, and improve pricing models, dashboards, and analytical tools used to evaluate profitability, margin performance, and pricing opportunities.

Analyze large and complex datasets from multiple sources to identify pricing trends, customer patterns, and commercial insights.

Conduct market, competitive, and margin analysis to support pricing decisions, new business opportunities, and strategic account reviews.

Partner cross-functionally with sales, finance, commercial leadership, field teams, and implementation teams to align pricing recommendations and execution plans.

Prepare clear reports, presentations, and data-driven recommendations for stakeholders, translating analytical findings into actionable business decisions.

Monitor pricing performance and business outcomes, and recommend adjustments to improve revenue quality, profitability, and competitive positioning.

Ensure pricing data integrity and support the maintenance of pricing documentation, governance practices, and process standards.

Drive continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to simplify workflows, automate reporting, and enhance pricing analysis capabilities.

Must be able to perform the essential functions with or without accommodations.

1+ years of experience in pricing, financial analysis, sales analytics, commercial excellence, business analysis, or a related field.

Strong analytical and quantitative skills with the ability to interpret complex data identify trends and translate it into actionable recommendations.

Strong proficiency in Excel, including formulas, pivot tables, data manipulation, and analytical modeling.

Experience with SQL and Power BI required; experience with ERP, Customer Relationship Management (CRM), or pricing systems is preferred.

Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate effectively across technical and non-technical audiences.

Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and perform effectively in a fast-paced environment.

High attention to detail, sound judgment, and a continuous improvement mindset.

Experience building pricing models, margin analyses, business cases, and performance reports.

Knowledge of pricing principles, discounting practices, contribution margin analysis, and profitability management.

Demonstrated ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise sound judgment with sensitive commercial information.

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Economics, Statistics, Data Analytics, or a related discipline required.

Airbyte is the data and action layer for AI agents. We give agents fast, accurate, authenticated access to business data across hundreds of sources, so they can discover the entities that matter, reason over real-time context, and take action in the systems they read from, not just observe them.



We started as the open-source standard for data movement and proved the economics of data integration at scale: hundreds of connectors, thousands of companies, and, since 2020, have raised $181M from leading investors including Benchmark, Accel, Altimeter, Coatue, and Y Combinator. As our CEO Michel Tricot puts it, "the last ten years were all about structured data. The future is all about context." We're now building that context infrastructure for production-grade agents on the same open foundation, as agents become the primary consumers of enterprise data.



Our mission is unchanged: make data available and actionable to everyone, everywhere. That everyone now includes AI agents.




THE ROLE:

Are you the kind of developer who gets a rush from cracking a gnarly replication bug, an issue with CDC implementation, or a query that hangs with no obvious reason? Do you thrive at the intersection of writing code and helping customers succeed? As a Customer Support Developer (Databases) at Airbyte, you'll combine hands-on development skills with deep technical empathy to support our growing cloud, embedded, and open-source integration platform. 



This isn't a traditional support role. You'll be writing Java and Kotlin, shipping contributions to our open-source database source and destination connectors, digging into query plans and transaction logs, and directly shaping how customers move mission-critical data between databases, warehouses, and lakes. You'll champion the customer voice alongside our engineering and product teams every day, getting your hands dirty in the code.




WHAT YOU’LL DO:

Customer Support & Technical Troubleshooting

 - Serve as the primary technical escalation point for database-related customer issues, responding via email, ticketing systems, and video calls with precision and clarity.

 - Triage and prioritize incoming issues with urgency, consistently meeting SLA targets while leveraging AI tools to work smarter and resolve issues faster.

 - Dig into complex issues across relational databases, data warehouses, data lakes, and cloud object storage, not just finding workarounds but partnering with Engineering to root-cause and drive real fixes.

 - Reproduce customer-reported bugs by inspecting connector logs, query plans, replication slots, transaction logs, sync state, and destination table state, and document findings with enough technical detail for Engineering to act on immediately.

 - Support customers through onboarding and troubleshooting for SSH tunnels, network configuration, database user permissions, CDC setup (WAL/binlog/redo logs), and warehouse/lake authentication.



Database Connector Development

 - Get hands-on with customers building and debugging integrations, helping them navigate Airbyte's database sources and destinations with confidence, from authentication and SSL/SSH setup to CDC, schema evolution, incremental cursors, and typed destination tables.

 - Validate database version compatibility across supported engines and releases, maintain testing environments, and reproduce customer-reported behavior on real database and warehouse instances.

 - Support customers writing to data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift), data lakes and object storage (S3, GCS, Azure Blob, Databricks, Iceberg), and databases (Postgres, MySQL, MSSQL, ClickHouse), including schema evolution and typed-columns behavior.

 - Help customers running database sources (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MSSQL, Oracle, MongoDB, and more) troubleshoot replication behavior, cursor selection, full-refresh vs. incremental vs. CDC trade-offs, and sync state recovery.

 - Contribute directly to Airbyte's open-source database connectors and the Java/Kotlin Bulk CDK: fix bugs, improve error handling, harden schema-evolution and CDC paths, and submit pull requests to the Airbyte repository.

 - Review and test community contributions to database sources and destinations, helping external contributors land high-quality changes.

 - Stay sharp on Airbyte's connector catalog, new database and destination releases, and platform updates so your guidance is always accurate and timely.



Cross-Functional Collaboration & Enablement

 - Be the voice of the customer within Airbyte, working closely with Engineering and Product to surface issues, advocate for feature requests, and ensure customer pain points actually influence the database reliability and performance roadmap.

 - Partner with Solutions Engineering and Sales Engineering to provide white-glove technical onboarding for enterprise customers, including CDC architecture reviews, destination schema modeling, and production readiness assessments.

 - Train and mentor Technical Support Engineers on database connector concepts, including JDBC fundamentals, CDC patterns, schema evolution, query optimization, destination typing and normalization, and the Airbyte protocol (spec, discover, check, read, write).

 - Partner with Sales and Customer Success for technical conversations, onboarding, and expansion efforts, bringing the kind of product depth that helps close and retain customers.



Knowledge, Process Improvement, & AI 

 - Create and maintain internal and external knowledge base articles, troubleshooting guides, and database connector documentation to support scalability.

 - Document research and troubleshooting processes,( including CDC debugging, destination schema reconciliation, and performance tuning runbooks), to aid faster ticket resolution and team knowledge sharing.

 - Identify AI-driven opportunities for automation and process improvements that reduce support load and improve the customer experience.

 - Embrace AI-assisted workflows and contribute to developing playbooks and skills that encode repeatable troubleshooting procedures, connector debugging patterns, and onboarding Runbooks, enabling the team to scale expertise through automation.

 - Spearhead initiatives to fill organizational or support gaps and take ownership of unique projects.




WHAT YOU’LL NEED:

 - 2+ years in software engineering, data engineering, technical support, DevOps, QA, or a similar role supporting developers or technical users.

 - Fluency in SQL, with hands-on experience investigating query plans, isolation levels, and performance bottlenecks.

 - Proficiency in Java or Kotlin. You must be able to read, write, and debug JVM-based connector code. You'll be contributing to database sources and destinations, the Bulk CDK, and automation tooling.

 - Hands-on experience with relational databases, data warehouses, or data lakes, including concepts like CDC (Change Data Capture), schema evolution, and query optimization.

 - Experience with JDBC and common database drivers, and comfort debugging connection, authentication, SSL, and SSH tunnel issues.

 - Understanding of cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and data integration concepts, including ELT/ETL workflows.

 - Strong troubleshooting instincts, clear communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, and a growth mindset that keeps you improving even when things get hard.

 - High tolerance for ambiguity and a natural self-starter.




NICE TO HAVE:

 - Experience with PostgreSQL, MySQL, MSSQL, Oracle, MongoDB, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, ClickHouse, or similar relational and non-relational systems.

 - Experience with data lakes and open table formats (Iceberg, Delta Lake), and cloud object storage (S3, GCS, Azure Blob).

 - Familiarity with Airbyte's Bulk CDK or contributions to open-source database connectors.

 - Experience with container orchestration tools like Kubernetes or Docker and multi-tenant architectures.

 - Background supporting developer-facing or embedded/platform products in a B2B SaaS context.

 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines and GitHub-based open-source workflows.

 - Experience with AI-assisted development tools and building automated playbooks or Runbooks.




LOCATION:

 - Remote in U.S. (Pacific, Mountain, Central timezones)




WHY YOU'LL LOVE WORKING AT AIRBYTE:

At Airbyte, we believe great work happens when people feel supported, trusted, and empowered to grow. Our market-leading Total Rewards package is designed to help you thrive professionally and personally. Our benefits and perks include:

 - Flexible PTO with a culture that encourages at least 25 days off annually

 - 12-16 weeks fully paid parental leave for all parents

 - Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and dependents

 - 401(k) retirement plan

 - Professional development budget, conference sponsorship, and book reimbursement

 - Commuter benefits and monthly internet reimbursement

 - Breakfast and lunch in our San Francisco office

 - A collaborative, in-person culture focused on learning, growth, and impact



If you find this role exciting, we encourage you to apply even if you think you don’t meet all of the requirements!



We are not accepting agency submissions or recruiting firm support for this role. Unsolicited resumes will not be considered.

East Morgan County Hospital is a 25-bed licensed critical access facility, level IV trauma center, offering a full array of health care services and two clinic locations: Banner Family Medicine Brush and Banner Health Clinic Fort Morgan. East Morgan County Hospital is in Brush, Colorado, 1-hour northeast of Denver. Situated in the agriculturally rich South Platte River valley, Brush is home to 5,500 people and serves over 15,000. The community thrives on its rural pace and charm and is revered for its “Homegrown Happiness!” Nestled in the wide-open plains of northeastern Colorado, Brush boasts a rich history and limitless outdoor recreation. With award-winning fishing and boating nearby, numerous parks and biking trails, some of the best of Colorado is here.

Accredited by The Joint Commission and Designated as a Pathway to Excellence hospital, East Morgan County Hospital brings together state-of-the-art technology and an exceptional team of health care professionals to provide the most compassionate, innovative, and personalized care possible. As a District owned hospital, operated by Banner Health, East Morgan County Hospital can provide the small-town, close-knit atmosphere all while having the resources of a large hospital system in the rural setting.

POSITION SUMMARY
This position assesses, plans, implements, evaluates and documents nursing care of patients in accordance with organizational policies and in accordance with standards of professional nursing practice utilizing the framework for professional nursing practice and development. This position is accountable for the quality of nursing services delivered by self or others who are under their direction. This position utilizes specialized knowledge, judgment, and nursing skills necessary to assess data and plan, provide and evaluate care appropriate to the physical and developmental age of assigned patients.

CORE FUNCTIONS
1. Assesses patient physical, psychological, social, spiritual, educational, developmental, cultural and discharge planning needs. Reviews patient history and physical with patient/family and assures completion within appropriate timeframe. Reviews available information obtained by other health care team members. Reviews diagnostics and laboratory data and reports abnormal results to the physician(s) and other appropriate caregivers. Completes assessment and reassessments according to patient need and as outlined in policy.

2. Formulates a plan of care, including the discharge plan, utilizing assessment data and patient, family and health team input. Initiates a plan of care based on patient-specific needs, assessment data and the medical plan of care. Goals for patient are realistic, measurable and developed in conjunction with the patient/family. Considers the physical, cultural, psychosocial, spiritual, age specific and educational needs of the patient in the plan of are. Plans care in collaboration with members of the multidisciplinary team. Reviews and revises the plan of care to reflect changing patient needs based on evaluation of the patient’s status.

3. Implements the plan of care through direct patient care, coordination, delegation and supervision of the activities of the health care team. Provides care based on physician orders and the nursing plan of care, in compliance with policies and procedures, standards of care, and regulatory agency requirements. Delegates appropriately, and provides nursing supervision in the provision of care to patients by other licensed nurses and other personnel. Promotes continuity of care by accurately and completely communicating to other caregivers the status of patients for whom care is provided.

4. Evaluates the patient's and family's response to care and teaching, and revises the plan of care as needed. Evaluates patient progress towards goals and expected outcomes in collaboration with other health care team members. Evaluates patient's response and the effectiveness of patient teaching.

5. Documents assessment, planning, implementation and evaluation in the patient record. Documentation is legible, timely and in accordance with policy. Documentation reflects objective/subjective data, nursing interventions and patient's response to treatment. Notes physician orders accurately and in a timely manner.

6. Provides care based on the best evidence available and may participate in research activities within clinical practice. Participates in unit or facility shared leadership. Interacts and participates in the education, role development, and orientation of facility personnel, patients, students, families and visitors. Promotes/supports growth of others through precepting and mentoring when appropriate.

7. Contributes to society through activities that lead to excellent patient outcomes through timely, effective, efficient, equitable, and safe care. Actively participates in the improvement of national nursing quality indicators and outcomes. Such activities may include participating in professional organizations.

8. In some roles, this position may supervise staff and work flow of the department.

9.Interacts with all levels of staff in a variety of departments, physicians, patients, families and external contacts, such as employees of other health care institutions, community providers and agencies, concerning the health care of the patient. Interacts with other health care providers in numerous settings in order to report and ask for or clarify information. Also works with clergy to provide spiritual support. Synthesizes and prioritizes data from multiple sources to provide support for the human response of the patient and family to changes in health status.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
Must possess a current, valid RN license in state of practice, temporary/interim RN license in state of practice, or compact RN licensure for current state of practice. BLS certification is required. Additional certification or continuing education may be required based on area of practice.

Relates throughout the interview process the experience, training and education needed to perform the job. Experience in the clinical area for which he or she is applying is desired. Must maintain clinical performance competencies appropriate to the area in which they work as demonstrated through annual validations. Banner Registry and Travel acute care positions require a minimum of one year experience in an acute care hospital setting. Experience must include working in an acute care setting within the past 12 months as a Registered Nurse in the specialty area. Banner Registry and Travel physician practice positions require a minimum of one year experience as a Registered Nurse in a physician practice or an acute care setting. 

In a Home Health setting, team members must be able to operate personal vehicle and possess a valid driver's license. Auto insurance coverage is also required to be active and maintained.

An Arizona Criminal History Affidavit must be signed upon hire. Employees working for Banner Home Care AZ must possess an Arizona Fingerprint Clearance Card at the time of hire and maintain the card for the duration of their employment. Bachelor's degree preferred. Professional certification preferred.

Additional related education and/or experience preferred.

Overview
Know your territory. Find the connections. Help shape a new chapter in HS care.

IAI is preparing to launch a new therapy for the treatment of hidradenitis suppurativa (HS), also known as acne inversa, a chronic, complex, and often debilitating skin condition associated with significant comorbidities and a substantial burden on patients' quality of life. This launch marks the beginning of a broader product strategy, and additional indications are expected to follow, offering the successful candidate the opportunity to grow the role and scope of responsibility over time.
To support this launch, IAI is seeking a Customer Engagement Manager (CEM) who will work daily with specialized centers, particularly dermatology departments, as well as selected office-based specialists who play an active role in the care of HS patients.
The role combines scientifically grounded, needs-based product positioning with a patient-centered perspective, fostering collaboration across multidisciplinary stakeholders to support the optimization of care pathways within the HS ecosystem.
We are looking for someone who enjoys building: a person who sees the potential in a new conversation, makes connections across a complex landscape and takes ownership of turning a launch ambition into strong work on the ground.

Job Summary

The Customer Engagement Manager (CEM) is a field-based role that unites the competencies of key account management and network development, while serving as an Integrated Care Specialist. The position is responsible for the successful positioning and adoption of Incyte’s HS therapy among key hospital centers and specialist physicians within an assigned territory, while simultaneously supporting the sustainable improvement of patient pathways through the engagement with multidisciplinary care structures and regional expert networks.

Success in this role requires deep scientific credibility, convincing selling skills, and the ability to build trusted, long-term relationships with Key External Experts (KEE) and multidisciplinary care teams. The CEM acts as a strategic partner to centers of excellence, supporting them in their role as multipliers of best practice and in strengthening structured collaboration between hospital and office-based care.

Essential Functions of the Job

Network & Stakeholder Management:
Engagement: identify, build, and maintain long-term relationships with KEEs and multidisciplinary teams (e.g., dermatology, surgery, wound care) in specialized HS centers. Understand structures, decision-making processes and patient pathways to engage effectively.
Activation: identify and connect relevant stakeholders across the HS care ecosystem, including hospitals, office-based specialists, nursing and care networks, patient organizations, and regional decision-makers to strengthen structured, cross-sector collaboration to enhance HS patient care.
Product Positioning:
Strategy Development: Close collaboration with the marketing and brand team to develop tailored strategies that clearly communicate the unique value of our products, while addressing the needs and expectations of the target audience.
Communication: deliver convincing and needs-based communication of the product's value proposition and messages to hospital centers and office-based specialists, maintaining an in-depth understanding of the disease, treatment guidelines, clinical data, and the competitive landscape.
Territory & Account Strategy:
Develop and execute strategic Customer Engagement Plans for the territory to maximize appropriate product use, sales, and market share.
Organize local sponsorship activities and standalone educational initiatives and participate in local stakeholder meetings to facilitate scientific exchange, foster dialogue with external experts, and enhance awareness of disease-related topics.
Sales and Marketing:
Sales and promotion of INCYTE’s IAI products, while ensuring that customers have a comprehensive understanding of the product’s benefits and features.
Development and implementation of targeted sales and marketing initiatives to promote product acceptance and usage.
The position is responsible for proactively and sustainably using all available communication channels - including email, webinars, video conferences, telephone, and direct contacts - to ensure consistent and effective customer engagement.
Market Observation:
Market Information Provision: Collecting and analyzing market data to provide the overall CEM team with valuable insights that support their sales strategies. This includes information about market trends, customer needs, and competitor activities.
Trend and Competitor Analysis: Proactively staying informed about the latest competitor activities and analyzing how these could affect our commercial activities and communication.
Feedback and Recommendations: Regular feedback to management and the brand team to ensure that our products meet market requirements and remain competitive.
Reporting:
Management Communication: Regular communication to management about important developments and successes to ensure that all relevant information is incorporated into strategic planning.
Compliance & Governance: ensure full adherence to all applicable legal, regulatory, and internal company guidelines in every customer interaction and project. Qualifications (Minimal acceptable level of education, work experience, and competency)

Qualifications

University degree in a scientific discipline (e.g. pharmacy, life sciences) or a business degree combined with a strong scientific affinity.
Completed training as a Pharmaceutical Sales Representative („Pharmareferent“, § 75 AMG) and/or a degree in a scientific field is required.
Excellent ability to communicate complex scientific information clearly and credibly.
Strong communication, and networking skills, with high personal credibility and field leadership.
High degree of self-initiative, positive mindset, solution-orientation, and consistent results-orientation.
High level of personal accountability, integrity, discretion and team spirit.
Ability to work effectively in a dynamic and rapidly changing environment.
Curiosity to explore a new market and continually learn.
Able to analyze data and draw the right conclusions.
Fluent in German and English, both written and spoken (minimum requirement).
Flexibility and willingness to travel and stay overnight, given the size of the assigned territory.
Permanent residence within the assigned territory preferred.

POSITION SPECIFICS​

This position provides project, operational, and administrative leadership for the Department of Medicine's clinical and translational research enterprise. This role develops and coordinates a shared clinical research support model that expands investigators' ability to initiate, activate, and sustain clinical and translational research across Department divisions.

The position is designed to create a Department-level infrastructure  to support study start-up, IRB and regulatory navigation, standardized workflows, coordinator utilization oversight, investigator intake, and connection to institutional research resources.

The Manager of Research Project Management provides strategic, operational, and administrative leadership for a team of research professionals supporting complex research programs, centers, and initiatives; oversees the planning, delivery, governance, and continuous improvement of research project management services while ensuring projects are executed with scientific rigor, operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and effective stewardship of financial and organizational resources; partners with Principal Investigators, faculty, research leadership, sponsors, and institutional stakeholders to establish strategic priorities, optimize project management practices, and advance the University's research mission; leads organizational planning, workforce development, process improvement, and resource allocation to strengthen research capabilities and achieve long-term research objectives.

 

This profile is intended for managers responsible for leading research project management functions supporting multiple research programs, departments, institutes, or centers. Positions assigned to this profile are accountable for personnel leadership, operational management, strategic planning, and the overall effectiveness of research project management services.

Lead, supervise, mentor, and develop a team of Research Project Managers and related staff; oversee recruitment, onboarding, performance management, succession planning, and professional development

Establish performance expectations, monitor workload distribution, evaluate operational effectiveness, and promote a culture of collaboration, accountability, continuous improvement, and service excellence

Direct the delivery of research project management services across multiple research programs, centers, institutes, or portfolios to ensure projects are completed on schedule, within scope and budget, and in accordance with sponsor and institutional requirements

Develop, implement, and continuously improve standardized project management methodologies, governance frameworks, operating procedures, workflows, tools, templates, and reporting practices to enhance consistency, efficiency, and research outcomes

Oversee research project infrastructure, resource planning, capacity management, and staff assignments to effectively balance competing priorities and organizational objectives

Evaluate research methodologies, project execution strategies, data management plans, operational processes, and project performance metrics; recommend improvements to enhance quality, efficiency, scientific integrity, and organizational effectiveness

Serve as the primary liaison with Principal Investigators, faculty, leadership, sponsors, advisory boards, regulatory agencies, and external collaborators; facilitate multidisciplinary and multi-institutional research initiatives and strategic partnerships

Direct governance activities, monitor project portfolios, evaluate risks, resolve escalated operational issues, and ensure accountability for project milestones, deliverables, and sponsor commitments

Provide leadership and oversight to ensure compliance with federal, state, sponsor, and University regulations, policies, and ethical standards governing research, including human subjects, animal care, biosafety, export controls, data security, responsible conduct of research, and other applicable requirements

Lead the development, implementation, and monitoring of project reporting processes; ensure accurate operational, financial, compliance, and performance reporting for investigators, sponsors, and institutional leadership

Develop and administer departmental and project management operating budgets; oversee financial planning, resource allocation, expenditures, staffing forecasts, and financial reporting; advise leadership regarding funding strategies and resource utilization

Collaborate with research accounting, sponsored programs, finance, payroll, compliance, and administrative partners to ensure effective financial and operational management of research activities

Lead strategic initiatives and special projects that improve research operations, expand organizational capabilities, strengthen project management practices, and enhance institutional research competitiveness

Partner with research leadership to develop strategic plans, establish long-term organizational priorities, identify opportunities for program growth, strengthen collaborative partnerships, and support the expansion of the University's research portfolio

Monitor emerging trends, technologies, regulations, and best practices in research administration and project management; implement innovative approaches that improve organizational performance and research effectiveness

Represent the research organization on institutional committees, governance groups, and cross-functional initiatives related to research operations, project management, and strategic planning

Job Title
Assistant Vice President
 

 

Job Description Summary

 

 

Job Description

Job Summary

Responsible for driving business development, managing end-to-end commercial real estate transactions, and delivering strategic real estate solutions for corporate clients. The role focuses on revenue generation, transaction strategy, lease negotiations, financial analysis, portfolio optimisation, client relationship management, and stakeholder coordination to achieve commercial objectives and ensure high-quality service delivery.

Key Roles and Responsibilities

Business Development: Identify new business opportunities, develop client relationships, generate leads, prepare proposals, and drive revenue growth and mandate conversion.

Transaction Management: Lead end-to-end transactions, including property acquisitions, leasing, lease renewals, relocations, subleasing, dispositions, and early lease terminations.

Strategic Advisory: Develop portfolio-wide transaction strategies aligned with client requirements, market conditions, occupancy needs, and financial objectives.

Financial Analysis: Review cash flow projections, occupancy costs, lease-versus-buy evaluations, NPV, IRR, and commercial proposals to support informed decision-making.

Market Intelligence: Analyse market trends, rental benchmarks, property availability, and comparable transactions to identify opportunities and recommend optimal solutions.

Negotiation and Documentation: Lead commercial negotiations, review lease terms, and oversee preparation of RFPs, letters of intent, market reports, lease abstracts, and transaction proposals.

Client and Stakeholder Management: Manage key client relationships and coordinate with landlords, tenants, brokers, legal advisors, finance teams, and other stakeholders.

Governance and Risk Management: Ensure adherence to approved commercial terms, internal policies, documentation standards, and applicable legal and regulatory requirements.

Performance and Team Coordination: Monitor transaction pipelines, business development targets, delivery timelines, and reporting; coordinate resources and drive process improvements.

Qualifications and Experience

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Commerce, Real Estate, or a related discipline.

Relevant experience in commercial real estate, transaction management, leasing, business development, and client advisory; approximately 5–8 years preferred, subject to organisational grade requirements.

Demonstrated expertise in commercial negotiations, financial analysis, market research, and stakeholder management.

Key Competencies

Strong written and verbal communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.

Commercial acumen, analytical thinking, and financial reasoning.

Strategic planning, problem-solving, and decision-making.

Business development, client relationship management, and influencing skills.

Transaction execution, stakeholder coordination, accountability, and attention to detail.

Key Performance Indicators

Business development pipeline, new mandates, and revenue generation.

Transaction closures, execution timelines, and negotiated commercial benefits.

Client satisfaction, retention, and account growth.

Accuracy of financial analyses, market reports, and transaction documentation.

Compliance, risk management, stakeholder coordination, and operational efficiency.

Role Expectation: Independently manage assigned transactions and client engagements, deliver measurable commercial outcomes, develop new business opportunities, and support the Director in achieving strategic and operational objectives.

Being part of a growing global company.

Career development and a promote from within culture.

Job Description:

Keep the Enterprise Moving Behind the Scenes

Every large engineering organization depends on people who understand how the pieces fit together.

We are looking for an Enterprise IT Operations & Asset Management Engineer to provide critical operational support across a large, complex enterprise technology environment. This role sits at the intersection of change management, ServiceNow, configuration management, asset lifecycle management, software and hardware maintenance, licensing, procurement, and vendor coordination.

You will work across numerous engineering disciplines and help ensure that the infrastructure supporting the enterprise is accurately tracked, properly maintained, appropriately licensed, securely changed, and operationally ready.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys working across multiple areas of IT rather than being limited to a single technology. You will interact with engineering teams, service owners, security personnel, asset management teams, vendors, procurement organizations, and leadership.

MEANINGFUL WORK AND PERSONAL IMPACT 

What You'll Do

● Coordinate enterprise change management activities by reviewing Digital Services change requests, validating technical and operational information, and supporting Change Advisory Board activities across multiple engineering disciplines.

● Engineer and maintain enterprise asset information within ServiceNow, supporting the complete lifecycle of servers, storage, appliances, and other technology assets from deployment through retirement.

● Manage configuration and lifecycle activities by ensuring assets are accurately represented, deployed, decommissioned, and maintained within the enterprise asset management environment.

● Support hardware and software maintenance by coordinating vendor renewals, validating asset inventories and quotes, reviewing costs, and supporting the acquisition and renewal process.

● Coordinate enterprise software and hardware acquisitions by gathering technical and commercial information, submitting required security and purchasing requests, validating entitlements, and supporting purchase-order execution.

● Manage software entitlement information and ensure enterprise licensing records remain accurate for products and services used across the environment.

● Support enterprise technology vendor and product relationships by serving as an operational point of contact for Microsoft, Oracle, Dell, HPE, Cisco, and other technology providers.

What You'll Bring

● Experience working in enterprise IT operations, configuration management, asset management, service management, or a related technical environment.

● Experience working with ServiceNow or a comparable enterprise service management platform.

● Understanding of IT asset lifecycle management, configuration management, change management, or software/hardware lifecycle processes.

● Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple activities across different technical teams.

● Ability to understand technical information and translate it into accurate operational records, requests, reports, and actions.

● Strong attention to detail, particularly when managing asset, licensing, configuration, financial, or operational information.

● Ability to work independently and coordinate effectively with engineers, technical leads, vendors, security teams, procurement organizations, and leadership.

● Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Why this job is so unique for career advancement

Our program supports 28 different IT engineering disciplines, which means the technology environment is broad, interconnected, and constantly changing.

This position gives you exposure to that entire ecosystem.

You will work with teams responsible for servers, storage, networking, infrastructure, SharePoint, databases, directory services, Linux and Windows environments, Exchange, VDI, security, web services, search, and other enterprise capabilities. The existing role directly supports change activities across a broad collection of these engineering organizations.

Rather than becoming narrowly focused on one technology, you will develop an understanding of how enterprise technology is deployed, changed, tracked, maintained, licensed, and ultimately retired.

That makes this an excellent position for an IT professional who enjoys understanding the operational side of technology and wants to develop into a broader enterprise practitioner.

Why This Role Matters

Enterprise technology does not operate on engineering alone.

A server needs to be properly recorded.

A change needs to be reviewed and approved.

A software license needs to be available.

A maintenance contract needs to be renewed.

A new system needs to be properly acquired and entered into the environment.

A retired system needs to be removed from production and accurately reflected in the asset database.

When those activities are not coordinated, the organization loses visibility, creates unnecessary risk, and makes it harder for engineers to do their jobs.

This role helps make sure those things happen.

You will provide the operational discipline that allows engineering teams to focus on building and operating technology while maintaining accurate enterprise records, supporting compliance, and keeping the lifecycle of technology under control.

What Success Looks Like

Success means:

Enterprise assets are accurately tracked throughout their lifecycle.

Changes are properly reviewed, coordinated, and documented.

Hardware and software maintenance remains current.

Licensing and software entitlements are accurately managed.

Procurement and acquisition activities move efficiently.

ServiceNow information can be trusted.

Engineering teams receive the operational support they need.

Vendor relationships and technology renewals are properly coordinated.

Leadership has accurate information about assets, changes, costs, and operational activities.

Technology can be deployed, maintained, and retired without losing accountability or visibility.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO SUCCEED 

Bring your technology expertise and drive for innovation to GDIT. The Enterprise IT Operations & Asset Management Engineer must have: 

● Education: Bachelor of Arts/Bachelor of Science OR Equivalent experience.

● Experience: 8+ years of related experience 

● Security clearance level: TS/SCI w/Poly 

● US citizenship required 

● Role requirements: 

Ability to work independently and coordinate effectively with engineers, technical leads, vendors, security teams, procurement organizations, and leadership.

Strong written and verbal communication skills.

● Certification: Must be 8570 compliant with a Security + Certification 

● Location: Annapolis Junction, MD 

 GDIT IS YOUR PLACE 

At GDIT, the mission is our purpose, and our people are at the center of everything we do. 

● Growth: AI-powered career tool that identifies career steps and learning opportunities 

● Support: An internal mobility team focused on helping you achieve your career goals 

● Rewards: Comprehensive benefits and wellness packages, 401K with company match, and competitive pay and paid time off 

● Community: Award-winning culture of innovation and a military-friendly workplace 

OWN YOUR OPPORTUNITY 

Explore an enterprise IT career at GDIT and you’ll find endless opportunities to grow alongside colleagues who share your desire to drive operations forward.

We are looking for a Senior Decision Scientist to design and own mathematical risk thresholds across our insurance products. 
In this role, you will operate at the intersection of catastrophe modeling, capital modeling, and portfolio strategy, ensuring that each policy we write is evaluated against explicit capital requirements and aligned with long term growth and risk objectives. You’ll dive into the details, build practical solutions, and turn well grounded analysis into clear, actionable decisions that move the business forward.

We believe three things matter for every role at Lemonade: drive to push through challenges, efficiency that keeps standards high while moving fast, and adaptability that lets you pivot with data and AI insights. These aren't buzzwords, they're how we actually work.

Our AI-first approach isn't just a tagline either. We're building the future of insurance with AI at the center, and we need people who are genuinely excited to learn and grow alongside these tools.


IN THIS ROLE YOU’LL

 - Own and build the capital modeling framework, running catastrophe models and integrating their outputs to support portfolio management, growth planning, and strategic decision making

 - Build and maintain the analytical tools and data structures used for catastrophe, capital, and portfolio modeling

 - Evaluate how individual policies and portfolio changes impact capital requirements, PMLs, tail risk, and expected returns

 - Partner closely with insurance, finance, and underwriting teams to assess the impact of reinsurance structures, retentions, and limits on portfolio risk and capital efficiency

 - Translate capital and catastrophe model results into clear takeaways and recommendations that help guide growth and risk decisions

 - Approach problems with curiosity and good judgment, challenging assumptions when needed and contributing to a team that values learning and shared ownership


WHAT YOU’LL NEED

 - 4+ years of experience in CAT modeling, capital modeling, or quantitative risk analytics within P&C insurance or reinsurance

 - Solid grounding in statistics and probability, especially as applied to extreme events and heavy-tailed distributions

 - Proficiency in data science programming languages such as R or Python, and database query tools such as SQL

 - Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, Actuarial Science, or a related field

 - Understanding reinsurance structures and how they impact portfolio risk and capital is a plus

 - Ability to work remotely 

 - Enthusiasm about learning and adapting to the exciting world of AI – a commitment to exploring this field is a fundamental part of our culture.

Through acquisitions and collaboration, over the past 10 years Teledyne Marine has evolved into an industry powerhouse, bringing the best of the best together under a single umbrella. With technologies divided into 5 core segments; Imaging, Instruments, Interconnect, Seismic and Vehicles, Teledyne Marine sales staff can address not only brand level solutions, but turn-key, customized systems that leverage our full range of technology. Our goal is to provide one-stop purchasing capability, world-wide customer support, and the technical expertise to solve our customer's toughest challenges. A Sea of Solutions…..One Supplier.

For more information, visit our website at www.teledynemarine.com.

POSITION WILL BE BASED IN Brazil- São Paulo

The Sales Manager is responsible for Sales of Teledyne Marine products in the defined area both directly and through distributors, specific responsibility to support the Central & South America’s for Teledyne Marine’s Imaging & Instruments and Vehicles verticals.

Job Title:

Performance Leader

Onsite – Buffalo, NY

At Moog, you'll have the opportunity to apply your machining expertise to products that support some of the world's most advanced space and defense programs. For decades, Moog has been a leader in developing innovative technologies for spacecraft, launch vehicles, missiles, and flight-critical systems, helping shape the future of space exploration and national defense. Every component you produce plays a direct role in mission success, where precision, quality, and reliability are essential.

We are seeking a skilled Machinist I- 2nd shift who takes pride in craftsmanship and attention to detail. In this role, you'll manufacture complex, high-precision components used in critical aerospace and defense applications, working with advanced equipment and challenging technical requirements. If you're motivated by meaningful work, continuous learning, and the opportunity to see your contributions make a real impact, Moog offers a unique environment where your skills help make the impossible possible.

This position is eligible for a $3,500 sign-on bonus. To qualify, candidates must submit their application between July 20, 2026, and September 11, 2026, and is subject to the terms of the bonus agreement.

 To be considered for this role, here’s what you’ll need to bring with you:  

At least 1 year experience as a general machinist, CNC lathe experience preferred.  

Graduation from a formal manufacturing, machining, or CNC certification/training program may be accepted in lieu of the required manufacturing experience

Demonstrated ability to follow an escalation path as it applied to machining. 

Familiarity using various measuring equipment, including but not limited to, Micrometers and Dial Bore Gauges 

Competency in reading and interpreting blueprints and written work instructions. 

As a Machinist I, you will: 

Perform set-ups and run parts on a CNC lathe with milling capabilities to close tolerances, fine finishes, and complex geometry. 

Be responsible for the inspection of all work performed, setting up or adjusting gaging equipment, detecting unusual conditions, deviant parts; and when needed recognizing errors in blueprints and operation sheets. 

Interpret complex drawings, including GD&T blueprints, sketches and operation sheets

Work/Life Balance: Flexible paid time off, holidays and parental leave program, relocation assistance

Collaborative and Welcoming Workplace: Inclusive culture rooted in our values, enhanced by Employee Resource Groups, and team-building activities.

Our NA Innovation Center sits at the heart of The Coca-Cola Company’s next chapter of growth. NBCUniversal is looking for a Facilities Information System Manager! In this role, you will manage all aspects for the NBCU Enterprise Integrated Workplace Management System (IWMS) and related connected Information Systems. The IWMS is a core technology platform for NBCU enabling workforce labor scheduling, space management, move management, inventory, asset management & purchasing functions. You will work closely with business units through the company documenting business processing, mapping system configurations and architect system data repositories to drive reporting for decision making and day to day operations.

What You’ll Do:

Serve as the primary administrator for the Archibus Integrated Workplace Management System (IWMS), overseeing system configuration, functionality, security, user permissions, and access levels domestically and internationally.

Configure, program, test, validate, and deploy system enhancements while ensuring reliable performance across domestic and international locations.

Design, map, and maintain system fields, workflows, integrations, and business rules that support Facilities operations and enterprise business processes.

Ensure data integrity, system stability, and optimal platform performance through ongoing administration and continuous improvement.

Partner with the hosted solution provider to define business requirements, prioritize enhancements, coordinate system upgrades, manage customizations, and resolve application issues.

Lead user acceptance testing (UAT), quality assurance activities, and production deployments for system releases.

Evaluate new technologies and functionality that improve Facilities operations and user experience.

Develop and deliver user training, documentation, and ongoing support to maximize adoption and effective utilization of the IWMS.

Meet regularly with Facilities staff, business partners, vendors, and stakeholders to gather feedback, identify improvement opportunities, and optimize the overall user experience.

Design, implement, and continuously improve Service Level Agreements (SLAs), workflows, and business processes within the IWMS to support consistent service delivery across business units.

Partner with Office Services to support space management, occupancy planning, and employee move management.

Collaborate with the Maintenance, Repair & Operations (MRO) and Service Center teams to support work order management, preventive maintenance, asset management, inventory management, and customer service processes.
